name: How long does home addition plumbing installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does home addition plumbing installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of home addition plumbing installation depends on the project's scope. A simple bathroom addition might take a few days for rough-in and final fixture installation, while a more complex project involving multiple bathrooms or kitchens could take several weeks. We coordinate closely with other contractors to ensure timely completion, minimizing disruption to your construction timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies with project scope; a simple addition might take days, complex ones weeks.
